scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The closed-neighborhood parity equation, its Gaussian-elimination solvability, and the even-even uniqueness case are earlier results. The stated contribution is the full rook-family equilibrium producer-count polynomial and sharp minimum multiplicities. Only static strict binary equilibria are included; an equivalent enumerator in unindexed parity-domination/coding literature remains possible. Verification on bounded instances does not establish universal validity, which rests on the accompanying proof. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Exact producer-count distributions in parity public-goods games on rook networks
